pages.text: $(thing)CTCSS$() is a low tone sent under your voice. A repeater with an access tone only repeats stations sending it. On a handheld, TXT sets the tone it sends and RXT the tone it needs to hear (tone squelch; leave it off to hear everyone), and ENTER opens the $(thing)Offset$() page; a base station has buttons and knobs for both.$(br2)Example: repeater 146.340 in, 146.940 out: handheld on 146.940, offset -600.
